rules_left:
Skill Tests
Success Levels:
Fumble 100/96+ | Fail > % | Regular ≤ %
Hard ½ % | Extreme 1/5 % | Critical 01
Pushing a roll: Justification required; impossible in combat or for Sanity.
rules_right:
Wounds and Healing
First Aid: Heals 1 HP. Medicine: Heals 1D3 HP.
Major Wound: Loss ≥ ½ max HP in one attack.
Natural Healing: 1 HP / day.
Dying: 0 HP + Major Wound.
